patch_description: Crossover combining the current program's strengths (sparse-LP radii solver, wide candidate pool with multiple scales, Metropolis acceptance, best-per-basin tracking) with the crossover program's strengths (row-shift and block-shift collective moves, greedy pre-screen to skip expensive LP solves). The greedy compute_max_radii pre-screen rejects clearly bad trials cheaply, freeing time budget for more accepted moves; row/block shifts help escape local optima that single-circle moves cannot; Metropolis acceptance plus best-ever tracking retains exploration safety.
